attchmntText: Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Dividend  is 19-Nov-2026.
voiceSummary: NATCO Pharma Limited declared a second interim dividend of Rs. 1.25 per equity share for the financial year 2026-27. The record date for shareholders eligible to receive this dividend is Thursday, 19th November, 2026. Payment of the dividend will commence on 27th November, 2026. The announcement was issued by the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Ch. Venkat Ramesh, following a Board of Directors meeting held on 13th November, 2026.

attchmntText: Natco Pharma Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026 and declaration of 2nd Interim Dividend for FY 2026-27
voiceSummary: NATCO Pharma Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company declared a second interim dividend of Rs. 1.25 per equity share for the financial year 2026-27. The record date for this dividend is fixed as November 19, 2026. Payment of the dividend will commence on November 27, 2026. The financial results include a Limited Review Report from the Statutory Auditors.
